apps.localizedDescription: Run x86-64 Windows PC games on iPhone and iPad - no jailbreak. Madeira bundles FEX-Emu, Wine, and DXMT, and puts your GOG, Epic Games, EA app, and itch.io libraries in one place: sign in, download, and play. Requires iOS 18 or later. The IPA links straight to the official willfaust/Madeira GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.
apps.name: Madeira
apps.subtitle: Windows PC games on iOS

versions.localizedDescription: Adds a GOG section (sign in, library, downloads, Galaxy achievements and stats), an EA app section (library and downloads), and itch.io support. Epic Games downloads and cloud saves now work together. New store tabs when more than one store is enabled.

apps.localizedDescription: Stremio's official app: movies, series, live TV and add-ons in one place. These are Stremio's own builds, mirrored from their CDN (dl.strem.io) to GitHub so this repo can track them - the 2.1.1 (build 25) files were verified byte-identical to Stremio's official copies.
apps.name: Stremio
apps.subtitle: Freedom to stream

apps.localizedDescription: A native iOS content hub. The IPA links straight to the official DjangoCustard225/Vesper GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically. Requires iOS 27.
apps.name: Vesper
apps.subtitle: Native iOS content hub

versions.localizedDescription:
- Faster Usenet streaming, with quicker starts and fewer stalls.
- Actor pages now show birthplace, dates, aliases and a full biography in a sheet, with links to IMDb, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube and their website.
- Added a search field to the source picker.
- Settings now show whether SubDL, Usenet and add-ons are connected.
- Your SubDL key is checked when you save it, and you can remove it.
- Playback pauses for calls and Siri and resumes afterwards.
- Smoother scrolling and playback, and clearer error messages.

apps.localizedDescription: Playport runs Windows games - 64-bit and 32-bit - on a stock, non-jailbroken iPhone: install a game from your library, pick up a controller, and play. The game runs on the phone's own CPU and GPU - no PC, no cloud, no streaming. The IPA links straight to the official playportdev/playport GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.
apps.name: Playport
apps.subtitle: Windows games on iOS

apps.localizedDescription: A free, open-source on-device app manager and installer for iPhone and iPad. Import your signing certificate (P12 + provisioning profile) and Feather signs and installs apps right on the device - no computer needed. It browses AltStore-format sources, including this one, so your shelves work in Feather too. The IPA links straight to the official khcrysalis/Feather GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.
apps.name: Feather
apps.subtitle: On-device app manager & signer

apps.localizedDescription: An all-in-one retro game emulator for iOS, packing many systems - including Nintendo, 3DS and Wii cores - into one clean app. This is the project's Sideload JIT build from their official GitHub releases. The IPA links straight to the official Manic-EMU/ManicEMU release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.
apps.name: Manic EMU
apps.subtitle: All-in-one retro emulator

versions.localizedDescription: Improved 3DS performance, Azahar core and Home Menu improvements, Wii pointer fixes, and more.

apps.localizedDescription: The official iOS port of the Dolphin emulator: GameCube and Wii games on iPhone and iPad. These are the project's current public beta builds (the 5.0.0 line) in the Non-Jailbroken flavor, linked straight from the official OatmealDome/dolphin-ios GitHub releases, and this repo tracks new releases automatically. Full speed needs JIT, which a JIT enabler app can provide.
apps.name: DolphiniOS
apps.subtitle: GameCube & Wii emulator

versions.localizedDescription: Public beta 6 - adds JIT support on iOS 26.6 and iOS 27 beta, per the project's changelog.

apps.localizedDescription: MovieBox Pro's official iOS app for movies and TV streaming. The project distributes the IPA from its own site (movieboxpro.app) rather than GitHub; this repo tracks the site's current build automatically, and each entry links to that version's file on their CDN. There is no Apple TV version - their TV app is for Android TV only.
apps.name: MovieBoxPro
apps.subtitle: Movies & TV streaming

apps.localizedDescription: A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own. Bring your own sources. Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.
apps.name: Nuvio Enhanced
apps.subtitle: A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.

It keeps the stock YouTube bundle ID, so it installs as the YouTube app itself. Requires iOS 17+.

apps.localizedDescription: Provenance is a multi-system retro emulator for iPhone and iPad covering 60+ systems — Nintendo, Sega, Atari, Sony and more — with iCloud sync for ROMs, saves and artwork, RetroAchievements, controller skins and video filters. Open source by the Provenance team; builds link straight to their official GitHub releases.
apps.name: Provenance
apps.subtitle: Multi-system retro emulator — 60+ systems

versions.localizedDescription: 3.3.0: iCloud/CloudKit sync for ROMs, save states, BIOS files and artwork; a completely redesigned tvOS interface; a unified video filter and shader pipeline across cores; RetroArch GLES 3D core support; and a long list of core, controller and stability fixes.

apps.localizedDescription: StikDebug is an on-device JIT enabler and debugger for sideloaded apps on iOS 17.4 and later — it's what lets emulators like Manic EMU and DolphiniOS run at full speed without a computer attached. One-time setup needs a device pairing file and a loopback VPN (LocalDevVPN); on iOS 26 and later it uses its script-based JIT path.
apps.name: StikDebug
apps.subtitle: On-device JIT enabler and device toolbox

versions.localizedDescription: 3.2.2: fixes for the Utsuro, Henge and MeloCafe JIT scripts.

apps.localizedDescription: Cafari is a Chromium-based casting browser that sends YouTube and other web video to your CarPlay screen, a Chromecast, an AirPlay receiver or DLNA. Two catches: video on the car's own CarPlay screen depends on Apple-granted signing entitlements, so it may not survive re-signing with your own certificate; and each build expires about 90 days after release (this one on 2027-01-13), so it needs regular updates — the repo's sync bot tracks new builds.
apps.name: Cafari
apps.subtitle: A casting browser: web video to Chromecast, AirPlay, or the car screen.

apps.localizedDescription: The stock Twitch app with the TwitchAdBlock mod baked in — ads blocked on live streams and VODs, including pre-rolls, mid-rolls, feed banners and sponsor spots. It keeps the stock tv.twitch bundle ID, so it installs in place of the official Twitch app rather than alongside it.
apps.name: TwitchAdBlock
apps.subtitle: Twitch with ads blocked
